password.title: Password
password.description: Login password. Stored encrypted on Apify.

encryptedKey.title: TOTP Secret (encryptedKey)
encryptedKey.description: The 2FA authenticator secret used to generate TOTP codes. Accepts a base32 secret (e.g. 'JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP') or a full otpauth:// URI. Stored encrypted on Apify.

loginUrl.title: Login URL
loginUrl.description: Login page URL. Defaults to https://app.tjbdigitalservices.com

headless.title: Headless
headless.description: Run the browser headless. Set false for a local run to watch the browser (also honours the HEADLESS=false env var).
